common_contract_text:
# M01–M13 shared measurement evidence port (draft; no candidate execution)

Owner: /root/f04_merge_tests. New file: src/trading_research/measurements/common.py. Preserve existing Trade, TradeView, TransactionTapeView, WindowCoverage, CausalBar and M12 ReferencePrice wires.

## Minimal public API

`capture_trade_window(view, *, instrument: str, start: int, end: int, cut: int, published_at: int, definition_version: str, aggregation_unit: str, coverage: WindowCoverage, max_inputs: int = 4096, max_bytes: int = 8388608) -> CapturedTradeWindow`

`validate_trade_window(captured, view) -> None` recomputes the capture against the actual view and requires exact value equality. Consumers using a detached capture must call this at their admission boundary; a caller-supplied hash or dataclass is not certification. Capturing requires exact supported existing TradeLedger or TransactionTapeView, not arbitrary protocol objects returning invented facts. F05 remains preferred; legacy TradeLedger is explicitly labeled provider-domain-unavailable.

`CapturedTradeWindow` is frozen and contains only `window: MeasurementWindow`, `trades: tuple[Trade,...]`. No duplicate tape per cohort. `MeasurementWindow` is frozen with:

- instrument, start, end, cut, published_at, definition_version, aggregation_unit.
- source_kind (`f05_transaction` or `legacy_trade`), source_domains: sorted tuples of actual F05 root-key (provider,dataset,publisher_or_venue,channel,source_session); legacy empty with explicit unavailable status and cannot claim cross-feed source order.
- source_versions: sorted `(root identity, source content version)` tuples from all in-window actual resolved F05 rows, including explicitly ineligible rows (legacy uses trade.id/source_content_version); correction_ids: sorted actual impacted delta/correction identities; contribution_hash: digest of complete selected Trade records (not IDs alone).
- coverage: actual immutable WindowCoverage, coverage_id: its full digest, observed_duration_ns; support_status (`complete`, `partial`, `unobserved`) derived solely from coverage spans and selected source history; history_complete boolean derived from both, never accepted as an independent input.
- eligible_volume, excluded_volume (known F05 ineligible mass; legacy zero), buy_volume, sell_volume, unknown_volume, unpriced_volume, print_count: recomputed exact integers. Signed observed uncertainty remains `signed +/- unknown`; finite true-flow bounds only if history_complete.
- order_exact: recomputed within event-time ties from unique non-null order, separate from history completeness; covered_print_count: counts prints in coverage spans. A trade outside declared observed spans is a support conflict and fails capture, rather than silently counting its volume over unrelated exposure.
- max_inputs, max_bytes: exact admitted bounds. `id` digest covers every field including actual publication, source provenance and bounds.

Time semantics: requested interval is [start,end), usable event prefix is event_at >= start, event_at < end and event_at <= cut (never calculate cut+1 outside the timestamp domain); cut >= start; publication >= cut; every event known_at <= cut and event_at <= cut. Coverage instrument/start/end must exactly match; coverage.known_at <= cut. WindowCoverage already requires span right <= coverage.known_at <= cut; complete window requires its actual complete coverage through end. Quiet complete empty-window history is certified solely by actual coverage, never by vacuous source-row truth. Partial windows carry partial support and no false completion. Quiet but completely covered windows have zero counts/rates and complete history; zero covered duration is unobserved and rates unavailable. Coverage version cannot be reused with inconsistent bytes within a publishing service.

Input bounds: validate finite positive integer bounds and exact admitted view types before any capture materialization. Legacy view checks len(trades)+len(corrections) <= max_inputs and its configured max_events finite; F05 checks len(ledger.deltas) <= max_inputs and its declared max_records/max_bytes finite before asof/changes. The actual ledger already has a bounded tuple/dict representation. Check tuple lengths before copying/sorting; reject over-bound coverage spans/source domains/corrections before building outputs. Bound individual identity strings and serialized output bytes; no arbitrary generators are consumed. These bounds are conservative on total retained source contributions, including outside-window rows, so asof cannot allocate an unbounded hidden history. Exact capacity succeeds, one over fails without mutation.

F05 unresolved condition eligibility fails explicitly before producing an eligible capture; excluded known-ineligible mass and its source versions stay visible. F05 source domain: infer from actual ResolvedTransaction root keys and require one common fully declared domain within each time tie before trusting source order (matches existing TransactionTapeView). Distinct domains remain explicitly listed, with order ambiguity, never fabricated cross-domain ordering. Aggregation-unit mismatch is a hard error even when numeric flow matches. No standalone-trade plus MBP-trade merging at this port: F05 reconciliation must precede it.

Corrections: capture asof(cut) and changes(cut) from actual view; old capture values remain immutable. A replacement moving across an anchor changes the current source versions and affected correction IDs even if numeric sum is unchanged. `validate_trade_window` uses historical cut, so later corrections do not invalidate genuinely old evidence. Restore is recomputation from actual restored source ledger plus exact original request and coverage, then compare receipt; no independent mutable certificate registry required.

F09 shared-bar adapter: `capture_bar_window(engine, publication_version_id, *, view, aggregation_unit, published_at, max_inputs=4096, max_bytes=8388608)` resolves the actual retained time-bar publication and its exact WindowRequest through `SharedBarEngine.window_publication`. It recaptures the actual source and coverage at the bar's frozen cut and validates raw domain, requested start/end, all selected IDs/content versions/corrections and exact summary volume/priced volume/unknown/buy/sell/OHLC where identifiable. Reject forged, future, wrong-definition, wrong-source and activity-bar publications through this time-bar adapter. Activity membership has its separate whole-event adapter. The returned MeasurementWindow adds `source_bar_version` (None for direct trade capture) to its complete identity. Store the engine/publication request only as a private revalidation recipe, excluded from canonical payload; public consumers revalidate through actual retained publication plus source. This adapter is required by M04/M06/M07/M13; no legacy CausalBar is accepted as its own proof.

## Hand cases to register

1. +5,-2,+4 known exact source => buy9,sell2,unknown0,signed7; one second covered => count3/sec and quantity11/sec. Independent dimensions raw ticks/contracts/ns.
2. Same prints after switching aggregation unit or raw instrument => reject; same numeric +7 under another legitimate source version => different receipt identity. Equal data/cut with publication +1ns => different receipt identity.
3. Unknown print size4 plus known+3: observed signed bounds[-1,7]; complete tape finite; partial coverage history false and true signed bounds unavailable. Covered quiet one-second window => zero rate; uncovered window => unavailable rate.
4. Original +5 in anchorA, corrected at cut20 to event in anchorB: cut10 A=5, B=0 preserved; cut20 A=0,B=5, both current impacts recorded. Restored source ledger reproduces each captured prefix exactly.
5. Same timestamp +10,-20,+10 without shared ordering domain => close0, order ambiguous; source domains retained. Same printed numbers with valid unique local order => true H10/L-10.
6. max_inputs exactly retained count and exact output-byte capacity pass; one additional source record / one output byte less fails before consumer mutation. Reject unsized iterables and massive coverage tuple before copying.

This is a design proposal only. Registration, implementation, one whole-M-batch review, one consolidated repair and one shared verification remain in that order. Learned support/alpha/economics/future evidence remain gated.
implementation_design_text:
# M01/M02/M10 implementation design, source faithful and substantive upgrades

Shared draft binding: /tmp/m-common-envelope-draft.md SHA 02afd9b275ecabcc48c8d4015e17f4c9e5686edcffc99c60cc21b5401ce60cd5. Candidate code not executed. Own files: new measurements/common.py, cvd.py, tape_intensity.py and narrowly necessary CVD validation in tape.py; other tape profile/VWAP classes remain Mill's consumer compatibility surface, no signature changes. Nine units: M01, M01.SIGN_RESET, M02, M02.ADAPT_COHORT, M02.FIXED_COHORT, M02.OHLC, M10, M10.EFFICIENCY, M10.INTENSITY; 72 explicit phase slots retained.

## Exact public services

`measure_cvd(capture, *, view, anchor_id, opening=0)` returns frozen ordinary flow and anchor age, known-side fraction, raw buy/sell/unknown/signed, observed unknown bounds and true bounds only with complete coverage. Anchor is a declared measurement reset identity, not an F10 authenticated location. Interval increments compare only matching instrument/sign/reset/aggregation definitions and contiguous windows; session reset versus rolling-window differences are explicitly distinct. Existing cvd_reference remains literal baseline. Nonzero cumulative opening in the production service must derive from a preceding authenticated same-anchor capture (or be an explicitly versioned mathematical offset, not claimed observed flow); an arbitrary integer is only the legacy literal-reference input.

`CohortDefinition` freezes version, aggregation unit, hard intervals and optional continuous size-basis knots; max channels <=32; positive exact integer thresholds; no participant identity labels. Fixed source variants retain >=100 NY, >=75 London, source30–60 interpretation alternatives (inclusive upper 60 / display saturation unresolved), and train-frozen top35% by count. Hard partition includes excluded/below/above channels, never silently drops mass. Overlapping source filters are separately labeled and cannot be summed as a partition.

`fit_cohort_definition(training_captures, *, view, train_end, available_at, probabilities, weighting='count'|'volume')` takes bounded validated captures ending before train_end, all publications <= train_end <= available_at, homogeneous instrument/aggregation; deterministic weighted empirical integer quantile cutoffs, lower-bin tie policy: first size reaching the requested cumulative mass remains in the lower bin, next lower-inclusive threshold is that size+1. Top35% source filter is a named empirical quantile challenger with realized fraction and tie rule exported, never forced to exactly35% by splitting a print. No fit is executed before shared authorization. Equal thresholds produce explicit empty bins or registered merge policy, never auto-refit. Definition hashes include actual source receipt IDs and counts. Inference requires definition.available_at <= window.start and immutable version; source fixed definitions have no fitted provenance claim.

`measure_cohort_cvd(capture, *, view, definition, openings)` returns per-channel true OHLC of event-ordered cumulative reported-side paths, includes opening baseline, relative OHLC, first high/low times and order status, weighted count/volume support, unknown bounds and raw-source lineage. Uses one trade tuple; no per-cohort tape copy. Fraction weights for a nonnegative piecewise-linear hat basis on frozen size knots: endpoint saturation, at an interior size exactly two weights sum1. Hard/soft partitions each independently reconcile eligible mass; overlaps explicitly flagged. Fixed/adaptive variants remain distinct, no change to prior published assignments.

Unknown side never becomes inferred signed flow. Known-side path OHLC is exact if source order exact but actual-side extrema uncertainty remains explicitly separate. Missing history gives unavailable true extrema bound; selected observed known path can be provisional. Unknown-order batch high bounds [max(start,end),start+positive sum], low bounds [start+negative sum,min(start,end)], propagated against earlier extrema; times unavailable when ambiguity can alter them. Open may be the extreme and has an explicit opening marker, not an invented print timestamp. Whole prints unsplit at activity boundary; if F09 membership required consume actual whole-event bar contribution IDs and verify common capture, never reconstruct from minute net.

`measure_tape_intensity(capture, *, view, epsilon, price_origin=None, quote_summary=None)` returns covered duration, missing duration, count/gross/signed rates per second, size quantiles, order-aware same-side runs, interarrival summaries within continuous covered spans only, price first/last/high/low and progress, total absolute tick movement and speed, signed/gross effort and ratio. Missing prices or order ambiguity make corresponding path metrics unavailable; raw counts remain available. Zero effort status explicit; epsilon positive exact contracts and frozen definition/provenance rather than arbitrary online adjustment. Price-origin defaults to actual first observed price (then first-to-last progress); explicitly supplied quote origins require M09 authenticated same-window receipt. No detached quote ticks/certificate strings. Quote spread/depth changes remain absent until Herschel's concrete M09 port exists.

`FlowDecayDefinition` declares clock=`elapsed_ns` or `executed_contracts` or `event_count`, kernel=`box` or `exponential`, positive finite scale, version; return raw weighted signed/gross/unknown channels with support. Elapsed uses event-time age at cut (not available-time age); activity clocks accumulate whole events in causal order and become unavailable under tie ambiguity. No visits clock without authenticated visit state. Multiple registered scales stay independent features, no implied independent evidence.

## Fitted substantive ports

Simple `ConditionalFlowBaseline` fit on bounded homogeneous validated historical window rows: grouping by frozen prewindow session/spread/volatility context bins with exact context known_at<=start; expected count and gross/signed flow per covered exposure; empirical dispersion and pooled fallback for sparse cells. Progress baseline may condition on completed effort because it predicts conditional progress, but intensity baseline cannot condition on its own completed burst. Store source rows/fold IDs, fit cut and availability, frozen input/target/unit schema. Inference exports raw observed values, conditional means, residuals, support count, missingness and standardized residual only if positive dispersion; no martingale or causal-effect assertion.

Nonlinear effort-progress surface is a small train-frozen binned two-dimensional table with shrinkage to pooled mean, evaluated at identical windows alongside raw ratio and additive linear baseline. Explicit candidate metadata retains seasonal robust z, Poisson/NB, then Hawkes/HSMM/temporal models; no claimed fit or capability for unavailable learned processes. Poisson predictive count likelihood uses the fitted exposure mean; negative-binomial challenger uses explicit train-frozen positive overdispersion and falls back to Poisson when variance does not exceed the mean. Both preserve full normalization and zero-exposure cases. Complex process challengers remain disabled with the exact missing likelihood/kernel/stability/OOF prerequisite, not silently treated as implemented approximations. Future markouts are typed matured labels only; no future maximum or subsequent reversal chooses current burst start. Burst state uses registered rate threshold known before window, records first crossing and causal duration/completion; trailing non-crossing completes only when observed.

## Phase coverage

P0 concrete contracts/provenance above; P1 named independent gold/reference, suffix/correction/restart, unit/domain/coverage/capacity cases. P2 literal versus rate/residual/cohort/path/surface comparisons all preserve identical source windows. P3 exact fidelity only; fitted branches require recursive chronological OOF/calibration and rare-support reporting. P4 all source/fixed/adaptive/hard/soft/close/OHLC variants retained with information-versus-capacity and each source threshold ablations; no-component/selected2x2 controls. P5 consumer ports M03/M11/auction/Context/Location, fixed candidate opportunities and independently scored future role. P6 one-account/one-mini complete policy, all eligible days, independently reserved risk and fixed costs/execution stress remains empirically pending. P7 actual future captured receipts/parity/monitoring/rollback pending authorized future data. No deterministic correctness promoted to alpha.

## Resource and missingness policy

Bound all list/tuple inputs, channel counts, knots, training rows, context groups and serialized bytes before copying/work. Streaming mutations stage candidates then commit atomically; historical outputs frozen. Capacity exact+one-over and future/publication/coverage mismatches fail closed. Reference scans remain explicitly bounded reference implementations; do not claim constant-time production performance for ledger rereads. Optimize incremental reductions only under same shared verification, with no redundant architecture purely to claim ClassA. Economic/data-dependent phases remain explicitly pending.

## Binding F11 / TemporalFold publication boundary

Pure numerical fitting kernels return unpublished state only. They do not certify fold IDs, training provenance, OOF validity or inference eligibility. New adjacent measurements/measurement_fits.py supplies the single serving boundary for cohort quantiles, conditional expected-flow residuals and effort-progress surfaces. It accepts actual SemanticArtifactStore, exact CommitRef, retained transform node ID and typed ReadRequest, rather than caller-supplied fitted IDs.

Retain TemporalSampleV1 population and actual compile_temporal_fold result in a F11 fold node using validate_temporal_fold_evidence. FitEvidence must name that actual fold node, exact training_sample_ids/groups, matured LabelEvidence target refs and actual training ReadManifest nodes captured via ReadSession. F11 commit/read_commit validates the transitive closure, complete population, temporal dependency bytes, target clocks, actual training reads and all fitted ancestor routes. Caller fold IDs alone never qualify.

The measurement fit binder re-derives the requested fitted state from the actual retained admitted training-read rows and exact recipe; serialized state must equal the transform node's retained payload, and its raw measurement inputs must link to authenticated MeasurementWindow/source-version evidence. No arbitrary transform payload or copied calibration coefficients accepted. Family-specific pure kernels may be used for independent arithmetic reference, but public fitted-feature inference requires this binder.

At each feature publication bind the full schema/unit/target, original row/date group, decision cut and assembly time in ReadRequest; use validate_oof_producer against the actual verified commit for held-out features and downstream fit_feature routes. Actual fit completion must precede the inference window start/cut. Calibration or upstream learned transforms remain in the transitive closure; future-trained, in-sample and final-prediction substitution fail before numerical inference. Final/future operation still requires a declared temporal evaluation population and full fitted lineage; it cannot waive the same-date/exposure gates through a string mode.

Register M-F11-FIT-001 as an additional engineering integration requirement: two train rows x=1,3, distinct dates and matured targets; held-out x=5. Actual F11 transform moments mean2, population scale1 produce standardized held-out3. Actual fit_feature read of held-out row fails, and fitting completion after evaluation cut fails before publication. Reopen the real semantic store and validate the same committed transform. The fixture is synthetic; it creates no source-reading credit or empirical result. Prior V01 repair obligations are not silently closed by this local adapter.

Concrete F09 shared-bar adapter and independent M-COMMON-007 are now included because the profile/TPO/VWAP/footprint consumers require it.
compatible_existing_scope: measurements/tape.py CVD-only narrow validation; preserve all signatures
phase_schedule: register all families, implement all, one whole batch review, one consolidated repair, one shared verification
remaining: Empirical chronological OOF/calibration and comparison outcomes remain pending.
Complete policy economics and actual future evidence remain pending.
Sophisticated point-process/HSMM/temporal challengers remain explicitly gated by complete model/data/likelihood prerequisites; no false implemented substitute.
